choices.why: This pale ash desk with tapered legs is the most Nordic option, and at 118 × 45 cm it fits neatly beside the window without crowding the reading corner.
It has a light wood frame, a padded linen seat and back, and casters, so it is truly comfortable for long hours while matching the desk's pale wood.
This tall birch bookcase wall uses the long white right-hand wall, holds plenty of books, and keeps them dust-free behind light glass doors.
The birch bentwood rocker with an off-white cushion is pure Scandinavian style and an inviting spot for reading by the window.
Its adjustable swing arm puts the light right over the book, and the white shade on a nickel stand stays light and minimal.

answer.why: Birch, ash and pale oak pick up the tone of the wooden floor, and the white and off-white textiles blend with the walls, giving a bright, cohesive Nordic corner. The desk faces the window and the reading area sits next to the bookcase.
